questions.cardDe: Was ist eine Bunad: norwegische Nationaltracht, schwedische Süßspeise oder dänisches Sportgerät?

timeline.labelEn: The word „bunad“ takes on its modern meaning: a Norwegian national (folk) costume
timeline.labelDe: Das Wort „Bunad“ erhält seine moderne Bedeutung: norwegische National- bzw. Volkstracht

questions.notes: Bunads are traditional or reconstructed Norwegian folk costumes, worn on 17 May and at weddings, baptisms and confirmations.

questions.en: Which 1948 German feature film does the term „Otto Normalverbraucher” (the German “average Joe”) go back to?

timeline.labelEn: Release of the film Berliner Ballade, in which Gert Fröbe plays Otto Normalverbraucher
timeline.labelDe: Der Film Berliner Ballade erscheint, in dem Gert Fröbe den Otto Normalverbraucher spielt

questions.notes: The card's statement (a Schiller poem) is false: the name was popularised by the film Berliner Ballade (1948), with Gert Fröbe as the returning soldier Otto Normalverbraucher.
